sightRead.reason: The sheet is a Cole Architects assembly legend (A601) with a WALL TAG LEGEND key decoding XC#A tags (C = core material: S = steel stud, C = concrete; # = core size: 6 = 6" steel stud, 8 = 8" steel stud / 8" concrete; 'X' prefix = rated, omitted when non-rated), so stud material and width for S6x/S8x are decoded through the tagKey and confirmed for S6A/S8A by the WP 1616 install text ("EACH SIDE OF 6", 18 MIL (25GA.), STEEL STUDS 24" O.C."). The rated types S6A/S8A are full tabular details with rating, UL listing, sound rating and leader notes; the B and C types are small tag boxes with one-line descriptions and an adjoining thumbnail section, so layer counts come from their own printed words. C8A/C8B are 8" insulated concrete form walls (not stud framing) with blank rating rows — nothing printed states a rating, so hourlyRating is left null there; "NON-RATED INTERIOR WALL" on the B/C types is recorded as 0 hours. For C8B the "1" RIGID INSULATION" and "(R-22) INSULATED CONCRETE FORMS" notes point into its own section, and its gyp is a single printed 5/8" board on the interior face only.
